definitions.gloss: to learn from experience; to come to realize; to be made aware
definitions.explanation: To deeply understand something through direct experience, often through hardship or failure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧さ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{知|し}った。
examples.english: I learned the importance of health the hard way.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{力不足|ちからぶそく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{知|し}らされた。
examples.english: I was made keenly aware of my own inadequacy.
examples.notes: Causative form: {思|おも}い{知|し}らされる

examples.japanese: ⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{初|はじ}めて→初めて：02932_hajimete⟧、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧{難|むずか}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{知|し}った。
examples.english: Only after failing did I truly understand how difficult it was.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
Pattern: [something]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{思|おも}い{知|し}る

ASPECT (ている):
{思|おも}い{知|し}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates having learned and retaining that understanding.

- {思|おも}い{知|し}らない (negative)
- {思|おも}い{知|し}って (te-form)
- {思|おも}い{知|し}った (past)

CAUSATIVE:
{思|おも}い{知|し}らせる - to teach (someone) a lesson
{思|おも}い{知|し}らされる - to be made to realize

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{身|み}→身：01764_mi⟧⟦をもって→をもって：06946_womotte⟧{思|おも}い{知|し}る - to learn firsthand
- ⟦{痛|いた}い→痛い：01108_itai⟧ほど{思|おも}い{知|し}る - to learn painfully
- {思|おも}い{知|し}らせて⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ - I'll teach you a lesson!

COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧ (think) + ⟦{知|し}る→知る：00458_shiru⟧ (know) → to come to know through thought/experience
